blocks.zh: 第五章：作業管理
blocks.en: Chapter 5: Operations

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 GDP 作業管理的核心精神：維護藥品身份識別、防止偽藥進入合法供應鏈
blocks.en: Understand the core purpose of GDP operations: preserving the identity of medicinal products and preventing falsified medicines from entering the legal supply chain

blocks.zh: 掌握供應商資格審查（Supplier Qualification）的強制要求及「盡職調查（due diligence）」的五項風險指標
blocks.en: Master the mandatory requirements for supplier qualification and the five risk indicators of due diligence

blocks.zh: 理解客戶資格確認（Customer Qualification）的法律義務及異常銷售模式的監控責任
blocks.en: Understand the legal obligation of customer qualification and the responsibility to monitor unusual sales patterns

blocks.zh: 熟悉收貨（Receipt）程序的驗收要點及偽藥疑慮的處理流程
blocks.en: Become familiar with the key checks in the receipt procedure and how to handle suspected falsified products

blocks.zh: 掌握倉儲（Storage）管理的六大原則：溫濕度控制、清潔、FEFO 輪儲、防損、效期管理、庫存盤點
blocks.en: Master the six principles of storage management: control of temperature and humidity, cleanliness, FEFO stock rotation, protection against damage, expiry date management, and stock counts

blocks.zh: 了解廢棄（Destruction）、揀貨（Picking）、供貨（Supply）及進出口（Import/Export）的規範要求
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for destruction, picking, supply, and import/export

blocks.zh: 5.1 原則 | Principle
blocks.en: 5.1 Principle

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 GDP 作業管理的兩大使命
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Two Missions of GDP Operations

blocks.zh: 5.1 原則定義了整個第五章的兩個核心使命：
blocks.en: 5.1 Principle defines the two core missions of the whole of Chapter 5:

blocks.zh: 身份保持（Identity Preservation）：藥品從製造商到最終使用者的每個環節，其身份（品名、規格、批號）不能迷失或混淆。這涉及標籤管理、貨架管理、揀貨準確性。
blocks.en: Identity preservation: At every step from manufacturer to final user, the identity of the product (name, strength, batch number) must not be lost or confused. This involves label control, shelf management, and picking accuracy.

blocks.zh: 偽藥防堵（Falsified Product Prevention）：PE 011-1 要求批發商「用盡一切手段（all means available）」阻止偽藥進入合法供應鏈。這不是建議，而是法律義務。
blocks.en: Prevention of falsified products: PE 011-1 requires wholesalers to use "all means available" to prevent falsified medicines from entering the legal supply chain. This is not a recommendation but a legal obligation.

blocks.zh: 所有 5.2 至 5.9 的具體要求，都是實現這兩大使命的手段。
blocks.en: All the specific requirements in 5.2 to 5.9 are means of achieving these two missions.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 藥品供應鏈的「信任鏈（Chain of Trust）」
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Chain of Trust" in the Medicines Supply Chain

blocks.zh: 藥品供應鏈就像一條信任鏈（Chain of Trust）。製造商賦予每個批次「合法身份」（上市許可、批號、CoA），批發商的職責是在整個鏈條中維護這個身份不被篡改或替換。
blocks.en: The medicines supply chain is like a chain of trust. The manufacturer gives each batch its "legal identity" (marketing authorisation, batch number, CoA), and the wholesaler's duty is to make sure that this identity is not altered or replaced anywhere along the chain.

blocks.zh: 偽藥之所以危險，正是因為它們「偽裝成」合法藥品，利用供應鏈某個環節的疏漏混入。GDP 的每一項作業要求，本質上都是在鞏固這條信任鏈的每一個環節。
blocks.en: Falsified medicines are dangerous precisely because they "disguise themselves" as legitimate products and slip in through a weakness at some point in the supply chain. In essence, every GDP operational requirement serves to reinforce each link of this chain of trust.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 「外包裝資訊」的法律地位
blocks.en: Key Point: The Legal Status of "Information on the Outer Packaging"

blocks.zh: 「按外包裝資訊配送」意味著批發商不得依自己的判斷改變任何與產品描述相關的資訊。若外包裝標示的儲存條件為「2–8°C」，批發商就必須確保整個配送過程維持此溫度範圍，不得以「距離近、時間短」為由豁免。
blocks.en: "Distribute according to the information on the outer packaging" means that the wholesaler must not change, on its own judgement, any information relating to the product description. If the storage condition on the outer packaging is "2–8°C", the wholesaler must ensure that this temperature range is maintained throughout distribution, and may not claim an exemption on the grounds that "the distance is short and the time is brief".

blocks.zh: 這一原則直接連結到 5.5 的儲存管理及冷鏈管理要求。
blocks.en: This principle links directly to the storage management and cold chain management requirements in 5.5.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果一批進口藥品的外包裝因運輸損壞而看不清儲存條件標示，批發商應如何處理？（提示：「按外包裝資訊配送」原則在此如何適用？）
blocks.en: If the storage condition markings on the outer packaging of an imported batch become illegible because of transport damage, how should the wholesaler handle it? (Hint: how does the principle of "distribute according to the outer packaging information" apply here?)

blocks.zh: 「國家主管機關核准（authorised by the national authorities）」這個要求，對代理進口藥品的批發商有什麼具體含義？哪些文件可以證明「授權」？
blocks.en: What does the requirement "authorised by the national authorities" mean in concrete terms for a wholesaler that imports medicines as an agent? Which documents can demonstrate "authorisation"?

blocks.zh: 5.2 供應商資格審查 & 5.3 客戶資格確認 | Supplier & Customer Qualification
blocks.en: 5.2 Supplier Qualification & 5.3 Customer Qualification | Supplier & Customer Qualification

blocks.zh: 核心概念 合法供應商的兩種類型
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Two Types of Legitimate Supplier

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 明確限定了「合法供應商」只有兩種：
blocks.en: 5.2.1 expressly limits "legitimate suppliers" to two types:

blocks.zh: 持有批發許可的批發商（Wholesale Distribution Authorisation holder）：已通過主管機關認可，可合法從事藥品批發業務。台灣對應「藥商許可執照（藥品批發商）」。
blocks.en: Holders of a Wholesale Distribution Authorisation: wholesalers recognised by the competent authority as lawfully entitled to conduct wholesale distribution of medicines. In Taiwan, this corresponds to a pharmaceutical firm licence (pharmaceutical wholesaler).

blocks.zh: 持有製造許可的製造商（Manufacturing Authorisation holder）：製造商可直接供應其許可品項，無須另持批發許可。但許可範圍必須涵蓋欲採購的特定品項。
blocks.en: Holders of a Manufacturing Authorisation: a manufacturer may supply products within the scope of its authorisation directly, without also holding a wholesale authorisation. However, the scope of the authorisation must cover the specific product being purchased.

blocks.zh: 重要：任何其他管道（例如：個人、未持證的中間商、網路供應商）均不符合 5.2.1 的要求，即使價格更具競爭力也不例外。
blocks.en: Important: Any other channel (for example individuals, unlicensed intermediaries, or online suppliers) does not meet the requirements of 5.2.1, even if the price is more competitive.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 銀行的 KYC（了解您的客戶）
blocks.en: Analogy: Bank KYC (Know Your Customer)

blocks.zh: 銀行在開立帳戶時必須做 KYC（Know Your Customer）——核查客戶身份、評估洗錢風險。如果某個客戶突然大量進行小額現金交易，系統會自動標記為「可疑交易」並上報。
blocks.en: When opening an account, a bank must perform KYC (Know Your Customer): verify the customer's identity and assess money-laundering risk. If a customer suddenly makes many small cash transactions, the system automatically flags them as "suspicious transactions" and reports them.

blocks.zh: GDP 的供應商/客戶資格管理邏輯完全相同：
blocks.en: Supplier and customer qualification under GDP follows exactly the same logic:

blocks.zh: 5.2 = 銀行審查「哪些對象可以存錢進來」（供應商資格）
blocks.en: 5.2 = the bank vetting "who may deposit money" (supplier qualification)

blocks.zh: 5.3 = 銀行審查「哪些對象可以提款」（客戶資格）
blocks.en: 5.3 = the bank vetting "who may withdraw money" (customer qualification)

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 = 銀行的可疑交易監控系統（異常銷售模式監控）
blocks.en: 5.3.3 = the bank's suspicious transaction monitoring system (monitoring of unusual sales patterns)

blocks.zh: 金融監管與藥品監管在這個邏輯上驚人相似——都是為了防止非法活動利用合法系統。
blocks.en: Financial regulation and medicines regulation are strikingly similar in this logic: both aim to stop illegal activity from exploiting a legitimate system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 「定期複查（periodic recheck）」不能只做一次
blocks.en: Key Point: The "Periodic Recheck" Cannot Be a One-Time Exercise

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 和 5.3.2 均提到「定期複查」。這意味著供應商/客戶資格審查不是一次性作業，而是需要建立週期性的持續確認機制。
blocks.en: Both 5.2.3 and 5.3.2 mention "periodic recheck". This means that supplier and customer qualification is not a one-time activity; a mechanism for periodic, ongoing confirmation must be established.

blocks.zh: 以下情況應觸發立即複查（而非等到定期週期）：
blocks.en: The following situations should trigger an immediate recheck (rather than waiting for the periodic cycle):

blocks.zh: 供應商或客戶的許可執照即將到期
blocks.en: The supplier's or customer's licence is about to expire

blocks.zh: 接到主管機關通知（例如：某供應商被暫停許可）
blocks.en: Notification is received from the competent authority (for example, a supplier's authorisation has been suspended)

blocks.zh: 媒體報導供應商有品質問題
blocks.en: Media reports of quality problems at the supplier

blocks.zh: 客戶出現 5.3.3 提及的異常採購模式
blocks.en: A customer shows the unusual purchasing patterns mentioned in 5.3.3

blocks.zh: 實務應用 CDMO 的供應商資格管理（AVL 系統）
blocks.en: Practical Application: Supplier Qualification Management at a CDMO (AVL System)

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的採購作業中，供應商資格管理通常由「已核可供應商清單（Approved Vendor List, AVL）」系統化管理：
blocks.en: In CDMO procurement, supplier qualification is usually managed systematically through an Approved Vendor List (AVL):

blocks.zh: AVL 應包含供應商的許可證影本及有效期，系統自動提醒到期前 90 天複查
blocks.en: The AVL should hold a copy of each supplier's licence and its validity period, and the system should automatically remind staff to recheck 90 days before expiry

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 的盡職調查紀錄應作為新供應商審查報告的必要部分
blocks.en: The due diligence records required by 5.2.4 should form a mandatory part of the new supplier assessment report

blocks.zh: 針對高風險品項（如疫苗原料、稀有輔料），應每年複查；低風險品項可每兩年複查一次
blocks.en: High-risk items (such as vaccine raw materials and rare excipients) should be rechecked annually; low-risk items can be rechecked every two years

blocks.zh: 異常採購訂單（金額或數量超出歷史範圍）應觸發自動審核流程，由 QA 確認
blocks.en: Unusual purchase orders (value or quantity outside the historical range) should trigger an automatic review workflow, with confirmation by QA

blocks.zh: 5.2.4(v) 提到「out-of-range prices（價格異常）」是偽藥風險指標。但有時候正規廠商確實提供低價（如大量採購折扣）。你如何在 SOP 中定義「異常低價」的判斷標準？
blocks.en: 5.2.4(v) lists "out-of-range prices" as an indicator of falsified product risk. However, legitimate suppliers sometimes do offer low prices (for example, volume discounts). How would you define the criteria for an "abnormally low price" in an SOP?

blocks.zh: 5.3.3 要求監控「narcotic（麻醉藥品）和 psychotropic substances（精神活性物質）」的銷售模式。如果你的公司不銷售這類產品，5.3.3 是否仍然適用？為什麼？
blocks.en: 5.3.3 requires monitoring of the sales patterns of "narcotic and psychotropic substances". If your company does not sell such products, does 5.3.3 still apply? Why?

blocks.zh: 若一家新客戶出示的批發許可執照是黑白影本，而非彩色原件，你如何驗證其真實性？
blocks.en: If a new customer presents a wholesale licence as a black-and-white photocopy rather than a colour original, how would you verify its authenticity?

blocks.zh: 5.4 收貨 & 5.5 倉儲 | Receipt & Storage
blocks.en: 5.4 Receipt & 5.5 Storage | Receipt & Storage

blocks.zh: 核心概念 收貨查驗的三層把關（5.4.1）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Layers of Checks at Receipt (5.4.1)

blocks.zh: 5.4.1 的「收貨目的」包含三個面向，對應三種不同的查驗動作：
blocks.en: The "purpose of receipt" in 5.4.1 has three aspects, corresponding to three different checking actions:

blocks.zh: 正確性（Correct）：核對品名、規格、數量是否與採購單一致。防止「送錯貨」或「數量不符」。
blocks.en: Correct: Check that the product name, strength, and quantity agree with the purchase order. This prevents "wrong deliveries" and quantity discrepancies.

blocks.zh: 來源合法（Approved Supplier）：確認送貨方確為 AVL 清單上的核可供應商，並附有合法的供應文件（如 CoA、交貨單）。
blocks.en: Approved supplier: Confirm that the sender is indeed an approved supplier on the AVL and that valid supply documents (such as CoA and delivery note) accompany the goods.

blocks.zh: 無外觀損壞（Not visibly damaged）：包裝是否完整、有無受潮、壓損、標籤污損等。若有疑慮，該批次應隔離（quarantine）而非直接入庫。
blocks.en: Not visibly damaged: Check whether the packaging is intact and free of moisture damage, crushing, or damaged labels. If there is any doubt, the batch should be quarantined rather than put directly into stock.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 FEFO vs FIFO：為什麼效期優先（5.5.4）
blocks.en: Key Concept: FEFO vs FIFO: Why Expiry Date Comes First (5.5.4)

blocks.zh: 一般倉庫常用 FIFO（先進先出，First In First Out），但 GDP 要求 FEFO（先效期先出，First Expiry First Out）。
blocks.en: General warehouses commonly use FIFO (First In First Out), but GDP requires FEFO (First Expiry First Out).

blocks.zh: 差異在於：同一品項可能有兩個批次，批次 A 先到貨（先 In），但效期比批次 B 晚。若使用 FIFO，會先出批次 A；若使用 FEFO，則應先出效期更近的批次 B，確保市場流通的藥品永遠有足夠的效期。
blocks.en: The difference is this: the same product may exist in two batches, where batch A arrived first (first in) but expires later than batch B. Under FIFO, batch A would be issued first; under FEFO, batch B, which expires sooner, should go out first, so that product on the market always has sufficient remaining shelf life.

blocks.zh: 例外情況必須書面記錄（Exceptions should be documented）：例如客戶特別指定批次，或批次 B 已有待調查的品質問題，此時偏離 FEFO 的原因必須以書面記錄。
blocks.en: Exceptions must be documented: for example, when a customer specifically requests a batch, or batch B has a pending quality investigation. The reason for deviating from FEFO must be recorded in writing.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 超市鮮奶的貨架管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Shelf Management of Fresh Milk in a Supermarket

blocks.zh: 超市補充冰箱鮮奶時，新貨補在後面，效期較近的舊貨推到前面——這正是 FEFO 的原理。顧客從前面拿貨，總是拿到效期最近的產品，確保鮮奶在效期內被消費，也讓進貨量可以預測。
blocks.en: When a supermarket restocks the refrigerator with fresh milk, the new stock goes to the back and the older stock with the nearer expiry date is pushed to the front. This is exactly the principle of FEFO. Customers take from the front and always get the product closest to expiry, so the milk is consumed within its shelf life and purchasing volumes become predictable.

blocks.zh: 藥品倉庫的邏輯相同：倉儲人員不是「最新的最先出」，而是「即將到期的最先出」。這需要 WMS（倉庫管理系統）的支援，在揀貨時自動推薦效期最近的批次，而非讓人工決定。
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical warehouse works on the same logic: warehouse staff do not issue "newest first" but "closest to expiry first". This needs the support of a WMS (warehouse management system), which automatically recommends the batch with the nearest expiry date at picking, rather than leaving the decision to people.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 偽藥疑慮的強制通報義務（5.4.4）
blocks.en: Key Point: Mandatory Reporting Obligation for Suspected Falsified Products (5.4.4)

blocks.zh: 5.4.4 是整個第五章最具法律效力的條款之一：若懷疑收到偽藥，有兩個強制動作：
blocks.en: 5.4.4 is one of the provisions of Chapter 5 with the greatest legal force. If a falsified product is suspected to have been received, there are two mandatory actions:

blocks.zh: 立即隔離（Segregate）：將可疑批次與正常庫存實體分開，並標示「勿配送」，防止偽藥流出。
blocks.en: Segregate immediately: Physically separate the suspect batch from normal stock and label it "Do not distribute" to prevent the falsified product from leaving the premises.

blocks.zh: 通報主管機關（Report）：依國家法規向 TFDA（台灣食品藥物管理署）或相應主管機關通報。
blocks.en: Report to the competent authority: Report to the TFDA (Taiwan Food and Drug Administration) or the equivalent competent authority in accordance with national legislation.

blocks.zh: 注意：此條款不是「若懷疑則應考慮通報」，而是「應予隔離並依規定通報」。不通報本身即為違規。
blocks.en: Note: the provision does not say "if suspected, consider reporting"; it says the product "should be segregated and reported as required". Failure to report is itself a violation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 「不得直接放地板」的工程理由（5.5.5）
blocks.en: Key Point: The Engineering Rationale for "Not Directly on the Floor" (5.5.5)

blocks.zh: 藥品不得直接放置於地板，原因包括：地板是污染源（灰塵、清潔劑殘留、蟲害）、地板潮濕或溫度異常（尤其靠近地面）可能影響產品品質、叉車作業可能造成壓損。
blocks.en: Medicinal products must not be placed directly on the floor, for these reasons: the floor is a source of contamination (dust, cleaning agent residues, pests); a damp floor or abnormal temperatures near the floor may affect product quality; and forklift operations may crush the product.

blocks.zh: 例外情況：「the package is designed to allow such storage（包裝設計允許直接地面存放）」，如某些醫療氣體鋼瓶，底部有設計支撐結構。
blocks.en: Exception: "the package is designed to allow such storage", for example certain medical gas cylinders whose bases are designed with a supporting structure.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 冷鏈生物製品（Cold Chain Biologics）的收貨作業
blocks.en: Practical Application: Receipt of Cold Chain Biologics

blocks.zh: 對台灣無菌 CDMO 而言，冷鏈藥品（2–8°C 或 -20°C/-80°C）的收貨是高風險作業，對應 5.4.2「需特殊處理的品項應優先處理」：
blocks.en: For a sterile CDMO in Taiwan, receipt of cold chain products (2–8°C or -20°C/-80°C) is a high-risk operation, corresponding to 5.4.2, which says that items requiring special handling should be prioritised:

blocks.zh: 溫度記錄核查（Temperature Record Review）：運輸商應提供全程溫度記錄器（Temperature Logger）的報告。若冷鏈有任何斷鏈（excursion），必須在收貨時識別，不得入庫。
blocks.en: Temperature record review: The carrier should provide the report from a temperature logger covering the whole journey. Any cold chain break (excursion) must be identified at receipt, and the product must not be put into stock.

blocks.zh: 接收至存放的時間限制：冷藏/冷凍品從卸貨到入冷藏室的時間應在 SOP 中規定（例如：不超過 15 分鐘）。
blocks.en: Time limit from receipt to storage: The time from unloading to placing refrigerated/frozen goods in the cold room should be specified in an SOP (for example, no more than 15 minutes).

blocks.zh: 5.4.3 的隔離上架：即使冷鏈完好，所有收貨品仍應先置於「隔離區（Quarantine）」，直到 QA 確認可上市販售後，才能移至「已核可庫存（Approved Stock）」。
blocks.en: Quarantine put-away under 5.4.3: Even if the cold chain is intact, all received goods should first be placed in the "Quarantine" area, and moved to "Approved Stock" only after QA confirms that they may be released for sale.

blocks.zh: 5.5.4 說「例外情況必須記錄（Exceptions should be documented）」，但沒有說例外是否允許。你如何在 SOP 中定義「允許偏離 FEFO」的情況，以及所需的核准層級？
blocks.en: 5.5.4 says "Exceptions should be documented" but does not say whether exceptions are permitted. How would you define in an SOP the circumstances in which deviation from FEFO is allowed, and the level of approval required?

blocks.zh: 5.5.6 說「接近效期的藥品應立即從可販售庫存中撤出」，但「接近效期（nearing）」沒有定量定義。你的公司如何定義「接近效期」的警戒門檻（如：剩餘效期少於 X 個月）？這與客戶需求的最短剩餘效期如何對應？
blocks.en: 5.5.6 says that products nearing expiry should be removed immediately from saleable stock, but "nearing" is not quantitatively defined. How does your company define the alert threshold for "nearing expiry" (for example, less than X months of remaining shelf life)? How does this relate to customers' minimum remaining shelf life requirements?

blocks.zh: 5.5.7 要求定期盤點庫存，但沒有規定頻率。結合你對倉庫作業的了解，哪些藥品類別應有更高頻率的盤點要求？（提示：麻醉藥品、高單價藥品、冷鏈藥品各有不同考量）
blocks.en: 5.5.7 requires regular stock inventories but does not specify the frequency. Based on your knowledge of warehouse operations, which categories of medicines should have more frequent stock counts? (Hint: narcotics, high-value products, and cold chain products each raise different considerations.)

blocks.zh: 5.6 廢棄 & 5.7 揀貨 & 5.8 供貨 | Destruction, Picking & Supply
blocks.en: 5.6 Destruction & 5.7 Picking & 5.8 Supply | Destruction, Picking & Supply

blocks.zh: 核心概念 藥品廢棄的三個管控面向（5.6）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Three Control Aspects of Destruction of Medicines (5.6)

blocks.zh: 廢棄藥品的管控分三層：
blocks.en: Control of products for destruction has three layers:

blocks.zh: 識別與隔離（5.6.1）：待廢棄品必須有清楚標示（如貼上「待銷毀」標籤），並實體隔離於正常庫存之外。防止廢棄品意外流入供應鏈（這正是偽藥事件的一個常見途徑）。
blocks.en: Identification and segregation (5.6.1): Products to be destroyed must be clearly identified (for example, with a "For destruction" label) and physically segregated from normal stock. This prevents products intended for destruction from accidentally re-entering the supply chain (a common route for falsified product incidents).

blocks.zh: 合規銷毀（5.6.2）：藥品（尤其是麻醉藥品、細胞毒素）不能像一般廢棄物一樣丟棄，須依法規（如台灣《廢棄物清理法》、TFDA 相關規定）委託合格廠商處理。
blocks.en: Compliant destruction (5.6.2): Medicines (especially narcotics and cytotoxics) cannot be disposed of like ordinary waste. They must be handled by a qualified contractor in accordance with regulations (such as Taiwan's Waste Disposal Act and relevant TFDA rules).

blocks.zh: 記錄保存（5.6.3）：銷毀記錄是審計追蹤的必要部分。稽核員需確認廢棄批次確實被銷毀，而非被轉移他用。
blocks.en: Record keeping (5.6.3): Destruction records are an essential part of the audit trail. Auditors need to confirm that the destroyed batches were actually destroyed and not diverted to other uses.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 供貨文件（交貨單）的必要欄位（5.8）
blocks.en: Key Concept: Required Fields on Supply Documents (Delivery Notes) (5.8)

blocks.zh: 5.8 的交貨文件（delivery note / packing list）欄位要求與 4.2.9 的交易記錄高度重疊，但多了以下重要欄位：
blocks.en: The field requirements for the delivery documents in 5.8 (delivery note / packing list) overlap heavily with the transaction records in 4.2.9, but add the following important fields:

blocks.zh: 劑型（pharmaceutical dosage form）：如注射液、凍乾粉針、口服錠。防止不同劑型的同品名藥品混淆。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical dosage form: for example solution for injection, lyophilised powder for injection, or oral tablet. This prevents confusion between products of the same name in different dosage forms.

blocks.zh: 實際儲存地址（actual physical storage premises）：若收貨人（consignee）的法定地址與實際倉儲地址不同，必須標明實際存放地點，確保產品可追溯到實體位置。
blocks.en: Actual physical storage premises: If the consignee's registered address differs from the actual storage address, the actual storage location must be stated, so that the product can be traced to a physical location.

blocks.zh: 運輸與儲存條件（transport and storage conditions）：即外包裝標示的條件，確保配送商和收貨方都遵守。
blocks.en: Transport and storage conditions: That is, the conditions marked on the outer packaging, so that both the distributor and the recipient comply with them.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 揀貨的「雙重確認（Double Check）」邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Double Check" Logic of Picking

blocks.zh: 想像在黑暗中從藥箱裡拿藥——如果有兩瓶外觀相似的藥（如 10mg 和 100mg 劑量相差十倍），隨手抓可能致命。
blocks.en: Imagine taking medicine from a medicine box in the dark. If two bottles look similar (for example 10 mg and 100 mg, a tenfold difference in dose), grabbing one at random could be fatal.

blocks.zh: 5.7 的「確保揀到正確產品（correct product）」在實務上需要至少兩道確認：
blocks.en: In practice, the requirement in 5.7 to ensure that the "correct product" is picked needs at least two checks:

blocks.zh: 第一道：WMS 系統掃描確認（條碼/QR code 掃描後系統驗證品名、批號）
blocks.en: First check: WMS scan verification (after the barcode/QR code is scanned, the system verifies product name and batch number)

blocks.zh: 第二道：人工目視核對（品名、規格、效期）
blocks.en: Second check: Manual visual check (product name, strength, expiry date)

blocks.zh: 「剩餘效期符合（appropriate remaining shelf life）」則需在揀貨時確認：效期剩餘是否符合客戶的最短效期要求（如：客戶要求交貨時剩餘效期不少於 12 個月）。
blocks.en: "Appropriate remaining shelf life" must also be confirmed at picking: whether the remaining shelf life meets the customer's minimum requirement (for example, a customer may require not less than 12 months remaining at delivery).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 廢棄記錄的審計風險
blocks.en: Key Point: Audit Risk in Destruction Records

blocks.zh: 5.6.3 的「廢棄記錄保存」在稽核中是高頻查驗點。稽核員的邏輯是：「入庫的貨如果沒有全部出庫或正在庫存中，它去哪了？」
blocks.en: The "retention of destruction records" in 5.6.3 is a frequent audit focus. The auditor's logic is: "If goods that came into stock have not all gone out or are not still in stock, where did they go?"

blocks.zh: 如果廢棄記錄不完整，稽核員可能質疑：是否有批次被非法轉移或處置。因此，廢棄記錄應包含：廢棄日期、批次資訊、廢棄原因、廢棄數量、執行人員、主管核准、廢棄方式（如委託銷毀公司的收據/憑證）。
blocks.en: If destruction records are incomplete, auditors may question whether batches were illegally diverted or disposed of. Destruction records should therefore include: date of destruction, batch information, reason for destruction, quantity destroyed, personnel who carried it out, supervisor approval, and method of destruction (for example, the receipt/certificate from the contracted destruction company).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 CDMO 出口配送文件管理
blocks.en: Practical Application: Export Distribution Document Management at a CDMO

blocks.zh: Taiwan CDMO 通常需要同時符合 TFDA 及進口國（如 EU、美國、日本）的文件要求。5.8 的交貨文件設計建議：
blocks.en: A Taiwan CDMO usually has to meet the documentation requirements of both the TFDA and the importing country (such as the EU, US, or Japan). Recommendations for designing the delivery documents under 5.8:

blocks.zh: 採用雙語（中英文）的 Packing List 格式，確保國際客戶可理解
blocks.en: Use a bilingual (Chinese and English) packing list format so that international customers can understand it

blocks.zh: 「actual physical storage premises（實際儲存地址）」對中間代理商（Distributor）的情況尤為重要：若 A 公司是名義客戶，但貨物實際送至 B 醫院，B 醫院的地址必須出現在交貨單
blocks.en: "Actual physical storage premises" is especially important where an intermediary distributor is involved: if Company A is the nominal customer but the goods are actually delivered to Hospital B, Hospital B's address must appear on the delivery note

blocks.zh: 冷鏈產品的交貨單應附上「Transport Validation Summary（運輸驗證摘要）」，確認運輸條件符合規定
blocks.en: The delivery note for cold chain products should attach a "Transport Validation Summary" confirming that the transport conditions meet the requirements

blocks.zh: 所有交貨文件的電子副本應在 WMS 或 ERP 中存檔，供日後追溯查詢
blocks.en: Electronic copies of all delivery documents should be archived in the WMS or ERP for later traceability queries

blocks.zh: 5.7 說揀貨時應確認「appropriate remaining shelf life（適當的剩餘效期）」，但未給出定義。若客戶的 Purchase Order 沒有明確要求最短剩餘效期，你的公司應如何在 SOP 中設定預設標準？
blocks.en: 5.7 says that appropriate remaining shelf life should be confirmed at picking but gives no definition. If a customer's purchase order does not specify a minimum remaining shelf life, how should your company set the default standard in its SOP?

blocks.zh: 5.6.2 要求銷毀符合「national or international requirements」，台灣哪些法規適用於藥品廢棄物的處置？（提示：考慮麻醉藥品管制條例、廢棄物清理法等）
blocks.en: 5.6.2 requires destruction in accordance with "national or international requirements". Which Taiwan regulations apply to the disposal of pharmaceutical waste? (Hint: consider the Narcotics Control Act, the Waste Disposal Act, and so on.)

blocks.zh: 如果一個客戶要求「不附送貨單，直接送貨以保密品項資訊」，這是否符合 5.8 的要求？你如何平衡客戶保密需求與 GDP 合規？
blocks.en: If a customer asks for delivery "without a delivery note, to keep the product information confidential", does this meet the requirements of 5.8? How do you balance the customer's confidentiality needs with GDP compliance?

blocks.zh: 5.9 進口與出口 | Import & Export
blocks.en: 5.9 Import & Export | Import & Export

blocks.zh: 核心概念 進出口的雙重授權邏輯（5.9.1 & 5.9.2）
blocks.en: Key Concept: The Dual Authorisation Logic of Import and Export (5.9.1 & 5.9.2)

blocks.zh: 5.9 確立了跨國配送的兩個核心原則：
blocks.en: 5.9 establishes two core principles for cross-border distribution:

blocks.zh: 國家法規優先（5.9.1）：進出口作業必須同時遵守出口國和進口國的法規。這不僅是 GDP 要求，也是一般貿易法律義務。
blocks.en: National legislation takes priority (5.9.1): Import and export activities must comply with the legislation of both the exporting country and the importing country. This is not only a GDP requirement but also a general trade law obligation.

blocks.zh: 雙向資格確認（5.9.2）：無論是從海外採購（Import）還是向海外供應（Export），都必須確認對方在其所在國是「有授權資格的」業者。不能只看本國法規。
blocks.en: Two-way qualification check (5.9.2): Whether purchasing from abroad (import) or supplying abroad (export), you must confirm that the counterparty is an "authorised" operator in its own country. You cannot rely on domestic law alone.

blocks.zh: 自由貿易區（Free Zone）的重要補充：即使在自由貿易區存放的藥品，如果流入「內部市場（internal market）」，仍須符合該市場的授權要求。自由貿易區身份不能作為豁免 GDP 的依據。
blocks.en: Important supplement on free zones: Even medicines stored in a free zone must still meet the authorisation requirements of the "internal market" if they flow into it. Free zone status cannot be used as a basis for exemption from GDP.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 台灣藥廠的出口實務情境
blocks.en: Analogy: A Scenario from Taiwan Pharmaceutical Export Practice

blocks.zh: 一家台灣無菌 CDMO 委製生產某客戶的生物製劑，產品在台灣已取得 GMP 許可，但尚未在台灣取得上市許可（僅供出口用）。
blocks.en: A sterile CDMO in Taiwan manufactures a biological product under contract for a customer. The product has GMP clearance in Taiwan but has not obtained a marketing authorisation in Taiwan (it is for export only).

blocks.zh: 5.9.1 的「防止未核可品進入內部市場」正是針對此情境：此批產品必須直接出口，不得在台灣市場流通，即使台灣有需求也不能供應（因為沒有台灣上市許可）。批發商負有確保產品不被「意外」引入本地市場的責任。
blocks.en: This is exactly the scenario addressed by 5.9.1, which requires preventing unapproved products from entering the internal market: this batch must be exported directly and must not circulate in the Taiwan market, even if there is demand in Taiwan (because there is no Taiwan marketing authorisation). The wholesaler is responsible for ensuring that the product is not "accidentally" introduced into the local market.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 進出口資格文件的查驗清單
blocks.en: Key Point: Checklist for Verifying Import/Export Qualification Documents

blocks.zh: 根據 5.9.2，跨國交易時，以下文件應予確認：
blocks.en: Under 5.9.2, the following documents should be confirmed for cross-border transactions:

blocks.zh: 出口方：台灣批發商的 GDP 許可、出口許可（如需）、TFDA 核准文件
blocks.en: Exporter: the Taiwan wholesaler's GDP licence, export permit (if required), and TFDA approval documents

blocks.zh: 進口方：進口國的批發許可或進口商資格證明、進口國的藥品上市授權文件（Marketing Authorisation）
blocks.en: Importer: the importing country's wholesale licence or proof of importer status, and the product's Marketing Authorisation in the importing country

blocks.zh: 藥品本身：確認產品在進口國是否已核准上市（若未核准，須確認是否有特殊例外，如臨床試驗用藥）
blocks.en: The product itself: confirm whether the product is approved for marketing in the importing country (if not, confirm whether a special exception applies, such as investigational medicines for clinical trials)

blocks.zh: 「authorized or entitled（授權或有資格）」涵蓋兩種情況：透過正式許可授權，或依法律條文自動具有資格（如某些國家的藥師可直接向製造商採購）。
blocks.en: "Authorised or entitled" covers two situations: authorisation through a formal licence, or entitlement arising automatically under the law (for example, in some countries pharmacists may buy directly from manufacturers).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 台灣 CDMO 的跨境藥品流通合規策略
blocks.en: Practical Application: Compliance Strategy for Cross-Border Medicine Flows at a Taiwan CDMO

blocks.zh: 台灣無菌 CDMO 常見的跨境情境：
blocks.en: Common cross-border scenarios for a sterile CDMO in Taiwan:

blocks.zh: 委外製造再進口（Tolling）：原料藥在海外製造，半製品進口至台灣完成充填，成品再出口。需確認原料藥進口商、台灣 CDMO、客戶三方均具備相應資格。
blocks.en: Tolling (contract manufacturing and re-import): The active substance is made overseas, the intermediate is imported into Taiwan for filling, and the finished product is exported again. It must be confirmed that the API importer, the Taiwan CDMO, and the customer all hold the appropriate authorisations.

blocks.zh: 多國上市策略：同一批次可能同時供應美國（FDA 許可）和歐盟（EMA 許可）市場。交貨文件必須明確標示目的地國家及對應的授權基礎。
blocks.en: Multi-country marketing strategy: The same batch may supply both the US (FDA authorisation) and EU (EMA authorisation) markets. Delivery documents must clearly state the destination country and the corresponding basis of authorisation.

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗用藥出口（IMP Export）：臨床試驗藥品（Investigational Medicinal Products）通常尚未取得上市許可，但可依臨床試驗許可出口。此情況下 5.9.2 的「authorised」解釋需參照目的地國的 CTA（臨床試驗許可）文件。
blocks.en: Export of investigational medicinal products (IMP export): Investigational Medicinal Products usually do not yet have a marketing authorisation but may be exported under a clinical trial authorisation. In this case, the interpretation of "authorised" in 5.9.2 must refer to the CTA (clinical trial authorisation) documents of the destination country.

blocks.zh: 5.9.1 提到「自由貿易區（free zone）」內的藥品同樣受到 GDP 規範。台灣的科學工業園區（科學園區）或自由貿易港區（FTZ）是否等同於此處的「free zone」？對 CDMO 在港區的倉儲作業有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: 5.9.1 mentions that medicines in a "free zone" are also subject to GDP. Are Taiwan's science parks or free trade zones (FTZ) equivalent to the "free zone" referred to here? What does this imply for a CDMO's storage operations in a free trade zone?

blocks.zh: 若台灣 CDMO 向一個新的東南亞國家出口藥品，但你不確定對方公司在當地是否具有合法進口資格，你有哪些具體管道可以確認？（提示：對方國家的藥品主管機關網站、台灣TFDA的雙邊協議、國際藥商組織名錄等）
blocks.en: If a Taiwan CDMO exports medicines to a new Southeast Asian country and you are not sure whether the counterparty is legally entitled to import there, what specific channels can you use to confirm? (Hint: the website of the destination country's medicines authority, TFDA bilateral agreements, directories of international pharmaceutical trade associations, and so on.)

blocks.zh: 一批為美國市場生產的藥品，因客戶訂單取消，能否轉供台灣本地市場？根據 5.9.1 的邏輯，你需要確認哪些條件才能進行轉用？
blocks.en: A batch of medicines produced for the US market cannot be shipped because the customer cancelled the order. Can it be redirected to the Taiwan local market? Based on the logic of 5.9.1, what conditions must you confirm before it can be repurposed?

blocks.zh: 本章重點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心使命（5.1）：維護藥品身份識別，以「用盡一切手段」阻止偽藥進入合法供應鏈。
blocks.en: Core mission (5.1): Preserve the identity of medicinal products and use "all means available" to keep falsified medicines out of the legal supply chain.

blocks.zh: 供應商資格（5.2）：僅可向持有批發許可或製造許可的業者採購；新供應商必須完成「盡職調查」五項風險指標確認；定期複查。
blocks.en: Supplier qualification (5.2): Purchase only from holders of a wholesale or manufacturing authorisation; new suppliers must complete due diligence against the five risk indicators; recheck periodically.

blocks.zh: 客戶資格（5.3）：僅可供貨給有合法資格的業者；監控異常銷售模式，懷疑轉用/濫用時通報主管機關。
blocks.en: Customer qualification (5.3): Supply only to entities with legal entitlement; monitor unusual sales patterns, and report suspected diversion/abuse to the competent authority.

blocks.zh: 收貨三層把關（5.4）：正確性 + 供應商合法性 + 外觀完整性；偽藥疑慮必須隔離並通報；未確認可販售前，不得進入銷售庫存。
blocks.en: Three layers of checks at receipt (5.4): correctness + supplier legitimacy + physical integrity; suspected falsified products must be segregated and reported; nothing may enter saleable stock before it is confirmed as releasable for sale.

blocks.zh: 倉儲六大原則（5.5）：環境保護（溫/濕/光）/ 進貨清潔 / 安全存放 / FEFO 輪儲 / 防損防混 / 接近效期立即撤出；定期盤點並記錄異常。
blocks.en: Six principles of storage (5.5): environmental protection (temperature/humidity/light) / cleanliness of incoming goods / safe storage / FEFO rotation / protection against damage and mix-ups / immediate removal of products nearing expiry; carry out regular stock counts and record discrepancies.

blocks.zh: 廢棄管控（5.6）：識別 + 隔離 + 依法銷毀 + 完整記錄（防止廢棄品流回市場或記錄被質疑）。
blocks.en: Destruction control (5.6): identification + segregation + lawful destruction + complete records (to prevent destroyed products from flowing back to the market or the records from being challenged).

blocks.zh: 揀貨與供貨（5.7/5.8）：確保揀到正確品項及足夠剩餘效期；交貨文件需含六個以上必要欄位，包括實際儲存地址及運輸條件。
blocks.en: Picking and supply (5.7/5.8): ensure that the correct product with sufficient remaining shelf life is picked; delivery documents must contain more than six required fields, including actual storage premises and transport conditions.

blocks.zh: 進出口（5.9）：遵守出口國與進口國雙重法規；確認跨境交易雙方均具備合法資格；自由貿易區不豁免 GDP 義務。
blocks.en: Import and export (5.9): comply with the legislation of both the exporting and importing countries; confirm that both parties to a cross-border transaction are legally qualified; free zones do not exempt operators from GDP obligations.
